definitions.explanation: Materials and tools used for painting or drawing, such as paints, brushes, canvases, and pencils.

examples.english: I went to buy art supplies.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{画材|がざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This store has a wide selection of art supplies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{画材|がざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher told us to prepare our own art supplies for the art class.

notes:
Composed of {画|が} (picture, painting) + ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). A collective term for art and painting supplies. {画材|がざい}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ or {画材|がざい}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ refers to an art supply store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画材|がざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to gather art supplies
- {画材|がざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy art supplies
- {画材|がざい}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: art supply store
- {画材|がざい}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: art supply shop
- {画材|がざい}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: art supply set

EXAMPLES OF {画材|がざい}:
- ⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧: paint
- ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧: brush
- キャンバス: canvas
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧: pencil
- スケッチブック: sketchbook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}→文房具：12869_bunbougu⟧: stationery — general writing and office supplies
- {画具|がぐ}: painting tools — less common synonym
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: materials — more general, not specific to art
